desc: Implement divide-and-conquer polynomial multiplication to compute coefficients $E_T$ of $P(x) = \prod_{i=1}^N (1+B_i x)$.
Implement the loop to compute $W_T = \sum_{k=1}^N k E_T^{(k)}$ using the recurrence $E_T^{(k)} = E_T - B_k E_{T-1}^{(k)}$.
Compute the final answer using the formula $\sum_{T=0}^{N-1} T! (N-1-T)! W_T$.
